complete_recomputation_recipes.mathematical_limits:
Evaluate R71's nonprojected ruled continuation on an actual finite entry.

Input is a saved successful outward-coast finite Fourier IVP with a''=0 at
its endpoint. Use actual projected left velocity and the original material
angle, so the finite map matches its incoming first jet exactly. Its small
entry metric/frame defects are NOT discarded. The actual two-dimensional
metric and curvature are computed from derivatives of the resulting map;
the boundary second-jet defect is reported rather than silently removed.
All bounds here are samples, and this is still only a surface with boundary.

literal_reference_search.method: Read-only repository text search plus full small producer/consumer/note reads; no claim that indexed search proves absence of every possible future/dynamic consumer.

restoration_contract.exact_original_bytes: Fetch the stated fixed commit/blob into a read-only historical object store, then git show COMMIT:FULL_PATH or git cat-file blob GIT_BLOB to a scratch file. Compare expected bytes and whole SHA256 where recorded. Keep gzip bytes compressed unless the unchanged original consumer performs decompression.
restoration_contract.original_aliases: Map each recorded original local input path to the exact corresponding restored repository bytes. In particular the q106 and A32 repair aliases refer to their complete gzip certificates and original resource JSON, not just their small manifest or current solver field.
restoration_contract.original_sources: Use the explicit full original source record and sibling layout. f669, 4a6 and 6be flat bodies are distinct; do not substitute one for another. New exact 4a6 source has no historical commit assigned before root publication.
restoration_contract.full_original_parameters: Preserve every original actual resource argv and every complete config. Reconstruction commands explicitly mark values derived from complete producer/report; unrecorded original shell syntax, workflow, versions, OS exit status and resources remain null.
restoration_contract.future_recompute: Run only in authorized public Actions or later authorized scientific runner. Numerical/state/interval reports are regenerated from complete exact input files and full source/parameters; this retention does not run them. New timings, RSS, paths and platform-dependent serialization may differ.
restoration_contract.downstream_guard: A consumer requiring an original output whole hash must first restore original output bytes; do not relax its guard or give it a regenerated different whole hash.
restoration_contract.mathematical_status: No theorem, input, constraint, Fourier/radial domain, unknown run, failure or unpaid obligation changes. This is storage maintenance, not scientific progress.
